description: Review an AI transformation proposal, business case or rollout memo, for example before it goes to a board. Returns the do-first practices for the company’s size as a checklist, each with its evidence rating and wording that may show it, and how to find similar cases. You read the plan and decide for each practice whether the plan commits to it, rules it out or leaves it out. Pass the size and industry; the plan itself stays with you. For one figure in the plan, use check_ai_figure.

industry.description: The site’s industry category, if one fits: professional-services (consulting, accounting, audit, law), agencies (marketing, advertising, creative), ecommerce-retail (online shops, retail, wholesale), manufacturing. Map the user’s words, in any language, to one of these; if none fits (a bank, a hospital, a public body), leave it out.

size.description: Company size band: micro-small, medium, mid-market, enterprise (1–49, 50–249, 250–999, 1,000+ employees). Or pass employees instead.

name: review_ai_transformation_plan
title: Review an AI plan or business case
